Name: Seasonal Farmer Portraits for Split-Screen Co-Op
Author: kindtoeverykind
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/q86qPwT.png[/img][/center]
Heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226]Farmer 2.0 ESWF[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/155736848]saltyDG[/url] (which I highly recommend using for single-player and online multiplayer games), this is a content pack designed for split-screen co-op users utilizing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] as a framework.

The pack is designed for two split-screen players to be able to each have their own portraits displayed that will automatically change based on certain game conditions like season, weather, location, and special occasions. If anyone would like me to add support for player emotions, just let me know.


[u]The following are currently supported:[/u]

Conditions - Seasons and Weather
[list]
[*]Spring
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Default/Fair Weather Portrait (Sun/Wind)
﻿ ﻿- Rainy Weather Portrait (Rain/GreenRain/Storm)
[list]
[*]Summer
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Default/Fair Weather Portrait (Sun/Wind)
﻿ ﻿- Rainy Weather Portrait (Rain/GreenRain/Storm)
[list]
[*]Fall
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Default/Fair Weather Portrait (Sun/Wind)
﻿ ﻿- Rainy Weather Portrait (Rain/GreenRain/Storm)
[list]
[*]Winter
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Default/Fair Weather Portrait (Sun/Wind)
﻿ ﻿- Rainy Weather Portrait (Rain/GreenRain/Storm)
﻿ ﻿- Snowy Weather Portrait (Snow)

Locations - Desert, Island, and Mining Sites (Including Modded Locations)[list]
[*]Desert Portrait, which applies at the following locations:
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- The Calico Desert
﻿ ﻿- Walk to the Desert Redux Desert Locations
﻿ ﻿- Downtown Zuzu Desert Locations[list]
[*]Island Portrait(s)
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Default/Fair Weather Ginger Island Portrait
﻿ ﻿- Rainy Weather Ginger Island Portrait[list]
[*]Mining Site Portrait, which applies at the following locations:
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Pelican Town Mines
﻿ ﻿- Skull Cavern
﻿ ﻿- Ginger Island Volcano
﻿ ﻿- Cape Stardew Caves
﻿ ﻿- Downtown Zuzu Caves
﻿ ﻿- Sunberry Mines
﻿ ﻿- East Scarp Caves
﻿ ﻿- Sword and Sorcery Caves
﻿ ﻿- Lilybrook Cave
﻿ ﻿- Forager's Nooks and Crannies Cave

Special Occasions - Festivals and Weddings[list]
[*]Desert Festival Portrait
[*]Flower Dance Portrait
[*]Spirit's Eve Portrait
[*]Wedding Day Portrait
[/list]

***NOTES***
[list]
[*]I am not sure if I have the right location name down for every location (especially modded locations), so please let me know if you notice any errors!
[*]I intentionally included fewer options than [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226]Farmer 2.0 ESWF[/url]﻿ has because I am unsure if the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18384]Fashion Sense Outfits[/url]﻿ framework allows assigning outfits by player name (if anyone knows how to do such a thing with either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18384]Fashion Sense Outfits[/url]﻿ or another mod, please do let me know!). This means that currently, if players want their sprites to match their portraits, then they will have to change their clothes manually (either using in-game clothes or the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ mirror).
[*]However, if you would like me to add more portrait options, just ask and I'll see what I can do!
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DCZFINl.png[/img][/center]
Installation requires you to replace the example files in the assets folder with your own. For portraits, I used the [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Character Portrait Maker[/url] by [url=https://itch.io/profile/jazzybee]jazzybee[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] – either size should work (also make sure to toggle the background to be transparent so that your chosen background image or UI portrait background can be seen). For custom backgrounds, I just toggle them off and let my UI mods handle that, but you may instead use backgrounds such as those provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23337]Portraited Changing Skies[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6899]Portrait Frame Variations[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16980]Prince's Background Colors[/url], etc.

This may seem like a lot of steps for installation, so I am breaking it down into three small parts:

Part One:
[list=1]
[*]Download this mod and its requirements, which are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url]﻿, and the technically optional but highly recommended [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip them/paste their contents (for this mod, that will be the folder labeled [CP] Seasonal Farmer Portraits for Split-Screen) into your Mods folder.
[/list]
Part Two:[list=1]
[*]Open the [CP] Seasonal Farmer Portraits for Split-Screen folder.
[*]Go into the data folder and open the portraits.json with a text editor such as Notepad.
[*]Find (Ctrl + F) and replace all instances of Player1Name with the in-game name of your first player.
[*]Find (Ctrl + F) and replace all instances of Player2Name with the in-game name of your second player.
[*]Save the changes and close the file.
[/list]
Part Four:
[list=1]
[*]Go back to the main folder and then go into the assets folder.
[*]Rename the Player1Name folder to your first player's in-game name.
[*]Rename the Player2Name folder to your second player's in-game name.
[*]Within each folder and all its subfolders, replace the png files for each option you plan on using with your own png files. Make sure each file has the same name as the file you are replacing, and that you are putting each one in the correct folder.
[*]Now you are done! Load up your game and set the configurations to your liking!
[/list]

***NOTES***
[list]
[*]Make sure the player names that you put into the json files and the assets folders match the in-game names [i]exactly[/i]. As far as I know, they [i]are[/i] case-sensitive.
[*]Make sure to save backups of your portrait files, because if I post an update to this mod, then you will need to delete the old folder before installing the updated version to prevent errors. You will also need to repeat the installation steps all over again. But hopefully it will be easier for you the following time(s)!
[*]I think the folder names are fairly self-explanatory, but if you need more explanation, then just ask. :)
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/VCFHag8.png[/img][/center]
This mod's configuration options can be enabled or disabled individually and are as follows:

Player 1 Portraits:[list]
[*]P1 Seasonal
[*]P1 Seasonal Rainy Weather
[*]P1 Snowy Weather
[*]P1 Desert
[*]P1 Island
[*]P1 Island Rainy Weather
[*]P1 Mine Sites
[*]P1 Desert Festival
[*]P1 Flower Dance
[*]P1 Spirit's Eve
[*]P1 Wedding
[*]P1 Use Custom Background
[/list]
All the same configuration options are also available for Player 2 Portraits, just with P2 at the beginning of each setting.

All portrait options are enabled by default. The custom background is disabled by default.

You will also need to configure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] to your liking. My personal configuration for that mod is as follows:
  "EnableMod": true,
  "ShowWithQuestions": true,
  "ShowWithEvents": true,
  "ShowWithNPCPortrait": true,
  "ShowMisc": false,
  "FacingFront": false,
  "UseCustomPortrait": true,
  "UseCustomBackground": false

Also, in Stardew Valley's in-game options menu, I recommend setting each player's UI Scale as low as you can so that there's room in the dialogue boxes for text to appear without it getting completely wonky.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/u0BlcBJ.png[/img][/center]
Incompatible:
[list]
[*]Other Farmer Portraits content packs (as far as I know, you should really just use one)
[*]Mods that add special weather conditions (you'll probably just end up with the default seasonal portrait showing)
[*]Mods that add new Desert, Island, and/or Mining Site locations and are not on the Special Compatibility list below (again, you'll probably just end up with one of the seasonal portraits showing)
[/list]
Compatible:
[list]
[*]Most UI mods
[*]Most other mods
[/list]Special Compatibility (at least, I hope all the locational portraits work with these lol):
[list]
[*]Cape Stardew
[*]Downtown Zuzu
[*]East Scarp
[*]Forager's Nooks and Crannies
[*]Lilybrook
[*]Sunberry Village
[*]Sword and Sorcery
[*]Walk to the Desert Redux
[/list]

***NOTES***
[list]
[*]If you would like me to add compatibility for other mods (weather and/or locational), then just let me know! It's especially helpful if you can provide the correct Weather and/or LocationName tokens I need to add, but no worries if you can't.
[*]This mod was made for 1.6, and compatibility with other game versions is untested. It is also untested with Android (can you even play split-screen co-op on mobile? idk). If someone wants to convert this mod for use with other versions, they can do so and send me the file to add to the mod page.
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/fWuFsmu.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Please do not reupload my mods as-is.
[*]Please do not involve generative AI with my mods.
[*]Please ask for my permission before uploading alterations or additions to my mods. This does not apply to translations. You do not need to get my permission for translations, but please send me the link so that I can add it to my mod page's description. :)
[*]Please credit me and link to my original mod if you post an alteration/addition to it.
[*]Please make my original mod a requirement for any alterations/additions, if possible.
[*]Please do not lock my mods or any alterations of them/additions to them behind a paywall. They must be provided for free. Also, please only post them on sites/pages that are relatively easy to access (so not, like, a members-only Naver post, for example).
[*]If I cannot be contacted in any way for over a month, you are allowed to upload alterations or additions to my mods, provided that you follow the other rules that I have specified on that mod's page.
[/list]

If you encounter any issues, please post them in the Bugs section or the comments section with a LINK to your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Do not post the text from the log or a screenshot from the log. This clogs up the page and makes it difficult for me to understand what's going on and help you. If you post text or a screenshot rather than a link, then I will tell you to provide a log next time and delete your submission.

The only time you are allowed to submit a report/comment about an issue without a link to your SMAPI log is if for some reason you literally cannot get one. If that is the case, please say so in your report/comment and provide as much detail about the problem as you can.
